content:
Alex: thinking aloud 1: propose a microtier for early-stage startups: low monthly fee, strict trial cap, auto-upgrade path. goal: capture growth customers without subsidizing spikes. thoughts?

Priya: agree in principle. need clear guardrails so we don't blow up shared pools. propose two caps: token-rate cap (qps/tokens per minute) and monthly token cap. both enforced server-side.

Marcus: sales perspective: startups often want "pay as you grow" but also hate surprises. recommend a soft-quota where we warn at 80% and offer 1-click top-up. top-ups are self-serve in Console.

Yvonne: billing ops note: implement a "gracepath" that allows 48 hours of temporary elevated capacity once per billing period for new customers. this avoids noisy signups causing instant throttles. need to encode in contract and UI.

Alex: sketch of microtier terms:
```
Micro Start: $49/mo, 10M tokens/mo, 50 tokens/sec burst cap
Warning: 80% usage triggers email + Console banner
Gracepath: 48h temporary uplift to 3x token/sec once per 30d, auto-revert
Overage: auto-topup pricing at 1.5x base rate, or hard throttle after gracepath
Eligibility: company < 25 employees or <$250k ARR
```

Marcus: add-on idea: startup commit pack (one-time) gives 200M tokens at discounted rate and 6-month price lock. useful for trials that convert.

Priya: implementation flags: enforcement via routing policy + metering service. will need tenant-level rate limiter plus monthly counter. also need signal for gracepath activation and SSO billing link.

Yvonne: accounting asks: how do we recognize revenue for gracepath top-ups? if it's auto-topup, recognize immediately. if customer uses gracepath and later converts to paid seat, apply credit. need clear flows.

Alex: UX: Console should show projected monthly spend if current rate continues. add CTA to purchase commit pack or enable auto-topup.

Marcus: contract snippet for microtier: "Micro Start plan includes monthly quotas and a one-time gracepath per billing period. Overages billed automatically unless customer disables auto-topup." keeps it short. legal to review.

Priya: telemetry requirements: per-tenant qps, token/min rolling 60m, gracepath activations, top-up events. dashboards + alerting for ops.

billing-bot: created ticket BILL-881: implement microtier metering + gracepath accounting (https://tickets.internal/BILL-881)

Yvonne: we also need to define downgrade behavior: if a customer exceeds 3 gracepaths in 90d, flag for sales outreach and consider soft-suspend until contract changes.

Alex: launch criteria: 1) infra + billing implementation (BILL-881) 2) Console buyflow + top-up UX 3) 2 beta customers converted from trials 4) legal sign-off on microtier T&Cs 5) finance sims for unit economics.

Marcus: I have two pilot candidates (edu SaaS + infra tooling startup). I'll intro them this week.

Priya: ETA: spike for rate-limiter and monthly counters by next Wed, prototype in 2 sprints.

Yvonne: finance will run sims after we get 3 sample profiles. target decision in 3 weeks.

Alex: cool. action items: Alex to draft marketing copy & simple contract snippet, Priya to own infra spike, Yvonne to own billing flows and accounting, Marcus to lock pilots. ping me with updates.

Marcus: ping acknowledged. :thumbsup:
